services.name: Night Out At Lacma Fall 2026
services.desc: Night Out at LACMA returns for an evening of art, food, drinks, and music under the stars. Celebrate this season's newly opened and ongoing exhibitions while exploring the museum after hours, including the David Geffen Galleries. Admission is free. Come check out L.A.’s most exciting restaurants presented by MAMA featuring Cafe Tondo, Seco, and the return of Hop Louie, plus many more. Enjoy food for purchase, free treats, cash bars, and a live DJ set to be announced. Night Out at LACMA is an all-ages, all-welcome event and is free to attend. RSVP is required.
